title: Favorableness
summary: FA'VORABLENESS, noun 1. Kindness; kind disposition or regard. 2. Convenience; suitableness; that state which affords advantages for success; conduciveness; as the favorableness of a season for crops;

inlines.v: FA'VORABLENESS, noun 1. Kindness; kind disposition or regard. 2. Convenience; suitableness; that state which affords advantages for success; conduciveness; as the favorableness of a season for crops; the favorableness of the times for the cultivation of the sciences.
